UPDATE till_users
         SET failed_pins = least(failed_pins + 1, 10000),
             locked_until = CASE WHEN (failed_pins + 1) % 5 = 0
                 THEN now() + least(interval '15 minutes'
                                    * power(2, least((failed_pins + 1) / 5 - 1, 7)),
                                    interval '24 hours')
                 ELSE locked_until END
         WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND id = $2
